text:
maria: Quick thread — wrapping up the GPTQ bakeoff across Llama/Mistral/Qwen. Sharing quick sanity numbers + recommended Dedicated deploy profiles. Want +1s to push a canary next week.

kevin: Thanks. Put the eval table and perf tradeoffs in-thread pls.

sasha: TL;DR: GPTQ-4 generally holds for completion tasks, some regressions on instruction-following for Qwen 14B. Detailed deltas below (all vs fp16 serving baseline):
- Llama2-13B gptq-4: MMLU -1.2pts, GMT-avg latency -18% (per-token), memory -42%
- Mistral-8x-7B gptq-3/4 mix: MMLU -0.6pts, GSM8K pass@1 -0.4pts, latency -26%, memory -48%
- Qwen-14B gptq-4: MMLU -2.8pts, instruction BLEU down ~1.5, but generation quality mostly ok for short prompts

aj: Any single-case catastrophes (hallucinations/regression tests) we flagged?

sasha: We ran the eval-suite-runner across our prompt-slices. Found 3 small regressions flagged by the safety/accuracy probe for Qwen on multi-step reasoning prompts (chain-of-thought). Not catastrophic but repeatable. Will add to regression dashboard.

bench-bot: Bench summary (p95 tail removed for brevity):
- Llama2-13B fp16: throughput 420 tok/s, median latency 40ms; gptq-4: throughput 510 tok/s, median latency 32ms
- Mistral-8x-7B fp16: throughput 460 tok/s, gptq-4: 590 tok/s
- Qwen-14B fp16: 380 tok/s, gptq-4: 470 tok/s
Memory footprints consistent with expected quant savings.

kevin: Good. What about AWQ and INT8 runs? Any wins vs GPTQ for accuracy or perf?

sasha: AWQ-int8 ran on a subset: accuracy losses larger on MMLU (~3pts) compared to GPTQ-4; latency similar-ish to GPTQ but memory slightly better. INT8-native also showed some instability on Mistral family unless we used per-channel calibration. Overall: GPTQ-4 is the sweet spot for these families.

maria: I'm adding recommended deploy profiles for Dedicated. Drop below is the JSON snippet we'll use as a starting point for canary slots (please review):

```json
{
  "model": "mistral-8x-7b",
  "variant": "gptq-4",
  "replica_size": "rtx-a6000-1",
  "batching": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 8192,
    "target_latency_ms": 120
  },
  "cache": {
    "kv_cache": true,
    "prefix_cache_ttl_s": 300
  },
  "slo": {
    "p95_latency_ms": 200,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.5
  }
}
```

aj: For Dedicated canary, set burst-capacity to 2x and a slow rollout (10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on quality delta > 1.0 MMLU or safety flags. I'll wire the rollout in the console once we have final model tag.

kevin: What about fallback stacks? If gptq-4 shows drift or we hit the regression gate, should we fallback to fp16 or AWQ-int8?

sasha: Fallback plan proposal: primary=gptq-4, fallback=fp16 (higher cost but safest), secondary=fallback-awq-int8 for throughput-only non-critical endpoints. We should not fallback to awq for instruction-heavy endpoints.

maria: Ops notes for oncall: watch for increase in "generation mismatch" alerts (we added a new alert) and for latency spikes when bboxes (KV cache) invalidation happens. Also track token-level cost delta in Console.

bench-bot: Saved eval artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/gptq-bakeoff/1778901234/ — includes raw MMLU/GSM8K/GPT4o-qa subsets and prompt-slices.

deploy-bot: Canary schedule created: start=2026-03-25T02:00Z, steps=[10,50,100], auto-rollback thresholds set per @aj instructions.

maria: Next steps: 1) @kevin please sign-off on canary profile, 2) @aj create rollout in console, 3) @sasha add regression tests for the 3 CoT prompts we flagged, 4) I'll open canary ticket and link eval artifacts. Aim to start canary on 25th.

kevin: +1 from me for Mistral profile. Will add one more perf run with longer sequences (2k) tonight.

aj: I'll set the rollout and smoke tests. tagging @oncall for heads up.

sasha: I'll convert the flagged examples into unit-tests and add to the regression dashboard.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. If anything new pops up I’ll update this thread. :thumbsup:
